=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1583-1590, 1827-1834, 1984-1991 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The three freshness-gate steps that run `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge`, and through it the update-mode `_merge_lease_gate`, set `MERGE_LEASE_SOFT_PATHS` and `MERGE_LEASE_MAX_HOLDERS`. They do not set `MERGE_LEASE_REVOKE_ENABLED` or `MERGE_LEASE_PRIORITY_HEAD_PREFIXES`, and minimax and luna add that `MERGE_LEASE_IDLE_MINUTES` is missing too. Only the release step at lines 297-299 passes them.
  WHY: The helper defaults (`true`, `auto/forward-merge-stable-`) override the operator's repo variables in these steps. As a result, `MERGE_LEASE_REVOKE_ENABLED=false` still honours and writes back `skip=` entries, so the record is not "byte-for-byte the old format". `MERGE_LEASE_PRIORITY_HEAD_PREFIXES=none` makes the tick and the gate disagree on queue order. The contract test `test_lease_revocation_and_priority_switches_reach_every_lease_path` only uses `assertIn` for POLL and so misses this. Severity disagreement: minimax, luna and glm said MAJOR (high), sonnet said NIT, and gemini gave no severity. The highest is used.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3160-3161 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `_merge_lease_pr_eligible`, assignment prefixes on the call to the shell function `_pr_wait_for_required_checks` (`PR_CHECKS_REPOSITORY="${elig_repo}" REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW="" FINAL_CI_MERGE_RESUME_ENABLED=false \`) persist in the caller's shell after the call returns.
  WHY: `_mt_merge_lease_tick` and `_mt_merge_lease_tick_multi` run in the same shell as `_mt_final_ci_merge_resume` (scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2391-2392). The leaked `FINAL_CI_MERGE_RESUME_ENABLED=false` makes the resume take its switch-off path on every tick, which silently disables the default-on final-CI merge resume. Severity disagreement: minimax said BLOCKER (critical), glm said MAJOR, and gemini gave no severity. The highest is used.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2330, 2984 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_merge_lease_split_soft` (`split_entries="$(_merge_lease_soft_entries)"`) and `_merge_lease_paths_intersect` (`lease_soft_entries="$(_merge_lease_soft_entries)"`) do not redirect stderr, unlike every other caller, which uses `2>/dev/null`.
  WHY: One invalid `MERGE_LEASE_SOFT_PATHS` entry re-emits the `::warning::` annotation on every call, which is once per holder per candidate in the multi-holder paths. Dozens of duplicate annotations bury real warnings. Lease decisions are unaffected. gemini cited lines 1515-1544 and 3022-3253 for the same two calls. Severity: NIT from sonnet, minimax, luna and glm; none stated by gemini.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1491 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `freshness_soft_input` jq (`[ $pr_files[0][]? | if type == "array" then .[] else . end ] | names`) reads only the first 100-file page of the paginated, slurped files listing.
  WHY: For PRs with more than 100 changed files, shared hard paths on page 2 or later are missed. `_merge_lease_split_soft` can then classify such a PR as soft-only and run the probe, which contradicts the Phase 4 rule "Any shared non-soft path keeps today's rule with no probe". The probe still fails closed, and no test covers a multi-page listing.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

The `_mt_*` names stay as thin wrappers (§6)." The wrappers map results to `_MT_PROBE_*`, including `ignored`. D9 rejects "a second, independent probe".

A near-verbatim copy now exists as `_pr_merge_tree_probe` and its `_pr_mt_git`, `_pr_mt_git_fetch`, `_pr_probe_repo_init` and `_pr_probe_repo_cleanup` helpers (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2069-2290; header comment at scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2063-2071). agents.d/merge-lease-parallel-p4-soft-paths.md:9-10 calls the conversion "pending" as out of scope, yet this PR edits review_merge_train.sh and its title claims phases 1-5. The two probe logs, `MERGE_TRAIN_PROBE_REPO` and `PR_MERGE_TREE_PROBE_REPO`, overlap, and the duplicated token-handling auth path invites drift.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:The env blocks of "Process each tracking issue" (around line 1586), "Run standalone stall recovery without active projects" (around line 1830) and "Run standalone PR sweeps without active projects" (around line 1987). | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: These blocks add `MERGE_LEASE_SOFT_PATHS` and `MERGE_LEASE_MAX_HOLDERS` but not `MERGE_LEASE_REVOKE_ENABLED` or `MERGE_LEASE_PRIORITY_HEAD_PREFIXES`; only the release step (lines 297-299) passes those two. The update-mode `_merge_lease_gate` (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1901) therefore always uses the helper defaults.
  WHY: With `PRIORITY_HEAD_PREFIXES=none`, the tick and the poll gate disagree on queue order. With `REVOKE_ENABLED=false`, the poll steps still honour and write back `skip=` entries, so the record is not "byte-for-byte the old format". The gap partly predates this PR, and the test's `assertIn` cannot catch it.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:_merge_lease_split_soft `split_entries="$(_merge_lease_soft_entries)"`; _merge_lease_paths_intersect `lease_soft_entries="$(_merge_lease_soft_entries)"` | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Neither call redirects stderr, unlike the other callers, so an ignored `MERGE_LEASE_SOFT_PATHS` entry re-prints the `::warning::` annotation on every call.
  WHY: One bad variable produces dozens of identical annotations per tick or review run and crowds out real warnings. Lease decisions are not affected.

  Expected change site: scripts/review_merge_train.sh: _mt_conflict_probe, _mt_git, _mt_git_fetch, _mt_probe_repo_init, _mt_probe_repo_cleanup.

The `_pr_*` copies are called a "near-verbatim copy". The header and agents.d/merge-lease-parallel-p4-soft-paths.md call the conversion "pending" as out of scope, yet the PR modifies review_merge_train.sh.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  Requirement: Phase 1 steps 1.1-1.4 (plan lines 215-224): `held_s=`/`merged=` on released, with `.state`+`.merged_at` read together; `queue_len=` on granted; `MERGE_LEASE_QUEUE_LEN` and `MERGE_LEASE_QUEUE_PRS`; a `MERGE_LEASE_QUEUE` line; an agents.d prefix.
  Expected change site: _mt_merge_lease_tick in scripts/review_merge_train.sh, _merge_lease_queue_first in scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh, agents.d/merge-lease-parallel-p1-metrics.md.
  Evidence of absence: Phase 1 is delivered as a `MERGE_LEASE_METRIC` line instead. The diff has no `merged=`, the `--jq '.state // ""'` read is unchanged, and there is no `queue_len`, no QUEUE_LEN/QUEUE_PRS and no `MERGE_LEASE_QUEUE` line. The wasted-hold baseline cannot be computed. This may reflect an unshown approved redesign.
